svg.title: From silica powder to a sintered 13 mm disk
svg.desc: Illustration, not to scale. Step 1: the silica spheres are dried in an oven and ground to a powder in a mortar. Step 2: the powder is pressed in a 13 mm stainless steel mold with 0.5 to 1 ton, about 35 to 70 MPa on the disk face; less packed the spheres poorly and more shattered them. Step 3: sintering. Held at 900 degrees C for 2 to 8 hours the spheres bond at their contacts and keep their shape; at 1200 degrees C they fuse and the disk bends.
